findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` has abstract `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data` members, but this subclass implements none of them. Since this handler is registered on `MetricAlertFire`, accessing `Detector.detector_handler` for a metric-alert detector attempts to instantiate an abstract class and raises `TypeError`, preventing detector processing.

findings.title: Evaluation docstring still documents a list return value
findings.body: This method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but its docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. That documents the old contract and can mislead callers implementing or consuming detector handlers.
